text:
alex: Anyone hit SCIM provisioning failures after we put the idp-proxy in front of the app? Getting SAML ACS mismatch and session cookie not passed.

jordana: Hmm... saw a handful of 401/400s in the SCIM connector. Can you paste the SAML error from logs?

alex: stacktrace:
```
WARN SAML: AssertionConsumerService mismatch
expected: https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs
got: https://proxy.internal.company/sso/acs
SAMLResponse: Audience/Issuer mismatch
```

sasha: Likely proxy rewrite changing Host/Origin. If proxy sets different host header the IdP will send ACS for the proxy domain. Two quick fixes: 1) preserve original Host (Host header) on upstream, or 2) configure IdP ACS to include proxy url (not ideal).

ryan: Cloudflare Argo/tunnel info: set origin_host_header to app.redwood.com and pass X-Forwarded-Proto/Host. Also ensure TLS passthrough if the IdP wants exact cert CN.

marie: Also saw SCIM tokens getting dropped — when session cookie isn't forwarded, the provisioning job expires and we get token regen churn. Are SCIM secrets encrypted with KMS or stored plaintext in our DB? If KMS, rotating while proxy changes could cause decrypt errors.

alex: We're using KMS-wrapped secrets. Error in logs: "KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED: ciphertext invalid" — suspect TLS termination layer changed encryption header or payload when proxy did CRLF normalization.

jordana: For RBAC mapping, a related issue: our SAML group attribute mapping uses NameID as externalId. If ACS changes domain, NameID format might change (email vs persistent). That breaks existing role assignments for a subset of users.

sasha: Short checklist I ran locally:
- nginx/proxy: proxy_set_header Host $host;
- preserve X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto
- disable response body rewrite for SAML POST responses
- verify cookie domain: Set cookie Domain=.redwood.com if proxy is app.redwood.com vs proxy.internal.company

ryan: Example NGINX snippet:
```
proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
proxy_pass_request_headers on;
proxy_buffering off;
```

devsecops-bot: [ALERT] scim-service returned 401 to provisioning job (job_id=prov-8923) at 2026-02-28T17:12:54Z

marie: Audit logging question: where can I see the exact provisioning sync events and which IdP user triggered them? The console shows last_sync but not the IdP subject.

sasha: Console: /console/audit?service=scim — includes event types scim.sync.start, scim.token.rotate. For SAML-originated actions, check /console/audit?source=sso which will include saml.subject and NameID (if included in mapping).

oncall-idp: I'll update the edge proxy to preserve Host and cookie domain, then do a canary for 10% of scim traffic. Alert me if you see 5xx or >3% 401s.

alex: Thanks — will run a one-off repro using the idp test app, and post results here. If we still see KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED we'll open an incident and roll back proxy config.

jordana: One more note — if you change NameID format for compatibility, add a migration that maps old externalId -> new persistent id for the RBAC store. Otherwise expect a wave of 'missing role' tickets.

alex: got it. tag me @jordana for the migration PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
